items.title: China lithium hydroxide futures debut; listing benchmark seen in line with expectations
items.summary: Guangzhou Futures Exchange’s sixth contract, lithium hydroxide futures, began trading Nov. 26. Analysts said the initial listing benchmarks were reasonable: the benchmark was 1,750 yuan/mt below the Nov. 25 spot price of 76,750 yuan/mt. The first-listed contract, LI2706, reflects expected supply and demand in June 2027 rather than current spot conditions, one analyst said. Lithium carbonate and lithium hydroxide prices remain within cost-conversion constraints, while hydroxide’s demand outlook is weaker, with high-nickel demand growth subdued and solid-state batteries not yet at scale. Hydroxide smelting capacity is ample. Based on the Nov. 25 close of the lithium carbonate January 2027 futures contract and the hydroxide listing benchmark, the futures spread was about 7,600 yuan/mt; the spot spread was about 9,150 yuan/mt.

items.author: 期货日报
items.summary: 【氢氧化锂期货今日上市交易！业内人士认为挂牌基准价符合市场预期】金十期货11月26日讯，新能源金属期货板块再添新成员，广期所第六个期货品种——氢氧化锂期货11月26日上市交易。 1. 业内人士认为，氢氧化锂期货首批合约的挂牌基准价较为合理，符合市场预期。“11月25日氢氧化锂现货价格为76750元/吨，期货挂牌基准价较现货贴水1750元/吨，贴水幅度不大，定价较为合理。”国信期货分析师李祥英告诉记者，LI2706作为首个挂牌合约，锚定的是2027年6月的供需格局，而非现货行情，1750元/吨的基差处于可接受区间。 2. 广发期货分析师林嘉旎认为，目前碳酸锂与氢氧化锂价差相对平稳，在成本转化约束范围内。碳酸锂中长期需求增长点更多锚定储能，而氢氧化锂下游高镍板块增长预期相对平淡，固态电池仍未进入规模化节点。目前氢氧化锂冶炼产能相对充足，整体驱动较碳酸锂更弱。以11月25日碳酸锂期货2701合约收盘价和氢氧化锂期货挂牌基准价计算，两者价差约为7600元/吨。目前现货市场电池级碳酸锂和氢氧化锂价差约为9150元/吨，处于合理区间。 （本内容及观点仅供参考，不构成任何投资建议）

items.title: Persian Gulf oil exports remain under pressure as crude prices reprice geopolitical risk
items.summary: Oil prices steadied early Thursday after rising for two straight sessions, as ongoing military conflict in the Middle East threatened a recovery in regional crude exports and raised concerns over supply disruptions. WTI hovered near $84 a barrel after gaining more than 4% over the previous two sessions. Brent settled below $95. Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia have continued, including on Ras Tanura, a major oil export hub. Iran also said two tankers transiting the Strait of Hormuz struck mines on Nov. 25. “As long as the conflict remains unresolved, crude prices should retain some risk premium,” said Ryan McKay, senior commodity strategist at TD Securities, adding that Persian Gulf oil exports have declined following repeated Iranian attacks. Trading is expected to be thin on Thursday due to the Thanksgiving holiday.

items.title: Trump officials briefly considered using Cold War law to reinstate Huang

The Cold War-era law gives the president broad powers to intervene in the economy. Officials said restoring Huang was vital to U.S. national security, but Nvidia’s board did not view the remarks as threats. items.title: Anthropic Becomes Wall Street BUZZ as Analysts at Same Firm Split
items.summary: Two analysts at Hedgeye Risk Management have sharply diverging views on Anthropic. Communications and software analyst Andrew Freedman said Wednesday that the stock was at an attractive level for long-term investors, citing its potential to become a new operating system for businesses and strong near-term demand. Global technology analyst Felix Wang recommended shorting the stock in a report to clients Tuesday, citing mounting difficulty financing data centers needed to secure computing capacity and concerns about long-term demand for Anthropic’s AI models. Wang sees the stock falling to $59; Freedman’s fair-value target is $92.

items.title: JP Morgan: AI capex to approach $1.4 tln next year, with growth inflection possible in 2028
items.summary: JP Morgan analysts said companies will issue $450 bln of investment-grade bonds in public markets next year to fund AI-related capex, even as the booming sector may eventually see growth peak. AI-focused companies issued $368 bln of investment-grade bonds globally this year, the bank estimated. AI-related capex is expected to nearly double to $1.4 tln in 2027, then stabilize in 2028, with growth slowing sharply as the industry matures. In a quarter in late 2027 or early 2028, market expectations for capex in the following quarter could be broadly flat as sector growth slows, the strategists said. The market reaction is difficult to predict, they added.

items.summary: 【摩根大通：AI资本支出明年逼近1.4万亿美元 2028年或迎增长拐点】金十数据11月26日讯，摩根大通分析师表示，尽管蓬勃发展的人工智能行业未来可能面临增长见顶的局面，但企业明年仍将通过公开市场发行4500亿美元投资级债券，为人工智能相关资本支出提供资金。据该行估算，今年专注于人工智能业务的企业全球投资级债券发行规模为3680亿美元。小摩策略师在报告中写道，2027年人工智能相关资本支出将接近翻倍，达到1.4万亿美元，随后一年趋于稳定。策略师预计，随着行业逐渐进入稳定发展阶段，2028年资本支出增速将大幅放缓。策略师写道：“由于整个行业的增长速度放缓，2027年末或2028年初的某个季度，市场对下一季度资本支出的预期可能基本持平。市场对此会作出积极还是消极的反应，目前还很难判断。”

items.summary: Trump adviser Jared Kushner urged Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in a Tuesday call to honor commitments made to Trump and advance the Gaza peace plan, Axios reported, citing three people familiar with the matter. The White House and Trump-led Board of Peace are frustrated by the lack of progress and believe Netanyahu is prioritizing his political future over Gaza. The call was positive, and Netanyahu reiterated his willingness to move forward, but Israel has taken no concrete action. The plan calls for Hamas to disarm, Gaza to be demilitarized and governance to pass to a Palestinian technocratic government. Six measures still await Israeli approval.

items.title: Fed Beige Book: U.S. economy grows modestly; consumer spending broadly flat
items.summary: Eight of the 12 Federal Reserve districts reported slight to moderate growth, while activity was little changed in four, the Fed's Beige Book showed. Consumer spending was broadly flat as households grew more price-sensitive and cut nonessential purchases; auto sales slowed and housing activity weakened amid affordability pressures. Employment edged up, with most firms holding staffing steady and hiring mainly to replace departing workers. Wage and benefit growth was modest but faster than in the previous report. Prices rose modestly as energy, transport, healthcare, insurance and tariff-related costs pushed up business expenses, though competition and consumer price sensitivity limited companies' ability to pass them on. Most districts expected slight to moderate growth to continue.

items.title: FCC approves SpaceX plan for up to 1 mln satellites to build space data centers
items.summary: The U.S. Federal Communications Commission approved SpaceX’s plan to deploy up to 1 mln satellites for an orbital data-center network to power complex AI computing, the first such project approved in the United States. SpaceX says the centers would run on solar power and use radiative cooling in space, reducing reliance on terrestrial cooling systems and water. Under an application filed in January, the satellites would orbit 500-2,000 km above Earth and communicate via laser links. Astronomers and industry groups warn the deployment could worsen orbital congestion, raise collision risks and disrupt observations; the American Astronomical Society and others urged the FCC to reject the application. Blue Origin has also applied to deploy space data centers and is awaiting regulatory approval.

Kuo: Forecasting AI chip shipments solely from power capacity and chip TDP is too simplistic
items.summary: TF International Securities analyst Ming-Chi Kuo said AI chip shipments, including GPUs and TPUs, depend on multiple factors. Estimating shipments solely from data center power capacity and chips’ maximum thermal design power (TDP) is too simplistic and does not reflect real-world operations. Chips do not run constantly at maximum power, while newer chips can generate more tokens on the same power supply, potentially boosting demand. In many workloads, running more chips at lower utilization may generate more tokens than running fewer chips at high or full utilization.
